legend: Each person has a first name and a second name. Two people are brothers if they have the same second name. Given two people, decide whether they are brothers.
input: The first line contains two words $F_1$ and $S_1$, the first and second name of the first person. The second line contains $F_2$ and $S_2$ for the second person. Every name consists of 1 to 20 lowercase English letters.
output: Print "ARE Brothers" if they are brothers, otherwise print "NOT".
